==Problem== Connie multiplies a number by 2 and gets 60 as her answer. However, she should have divided the number by 2 to get the correct answer. What is the correct answer? \textbf{(A)}\ 7.5\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 15\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 30\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 120\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 240 ==Solution== If x is the number, then 2x=60 and x=30. Dividing the number by 2 yields \dfrac{30}{2} = \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 15}. A second way to do it is to divide the number by 4, as you multiplied by 2 when you were supposed to divide by 2. So, \dfrac{60}{4} = \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 15}. ==See Also== {{AMC8 box|year=2005|before=First
Question|num-a=2}} {{MAA Notice}}
